svg.title: AkiDB published generation workflow
svg.desc: AX Fabric publishes a checksum-addressed bundle. Each AkiDB replica verifies it, builds a shadow projection, and switches its local serving pointer after activation. Rollback moves that pointer.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Published generation workflow

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Optional, and off by default. AkiDB serves a rebuildable local projection.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: AX Fabric publishes one generation

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inputs such as AX Wiki and DocProc become an immutable logical bundle.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Record the bundle and the control row

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: SeaweedFS stores the checksum object. PostgreSQL stores order and the pointer.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each replica builds a shadow projection

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Download, verify size and SHA-256, then build RocksDB, HNSW, BM25, and the graph.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Activate with compare-and-swap

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Schema, counts, and the checkpoint must pass before the active pointer moves.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Serve from the local pointer

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The replica switches its local pointer and answers reads from that projection.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rollback moves the pointer

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The previous verified generation stays intact. The failed one is not edited.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What stays where

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: SeaweedFS holds the canonical object. PostgreSQL holds publication order,

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the active pointer, and replica checkpoints. AX Fabric is the publisher.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each replica keeps a full local copy for its workspace and collection.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Replicas do not copy each other's live RocksDB or HNSW files.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: An already active generation serves from local indexes. That read does not

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: call PostgreSQL, SeaweedFS, or NATS. NATS can only wake a replica.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: --standalone does not enable this profile. The qualified envelope is the

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ubuntu AMD64 three-replica cell at 100k vectors by 768 dimensions.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The multi-shard coordinator is a separate capacity path. It fans queries

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: out and merges them. It does not replicate shard data or switch generations.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Authoritative Memory stays a separate experimental path and is off by default.
